decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (WP4088-G-EXT-EL B, WP4088-G-SS B and the PACAIR specification sheet for unit RAS-4M27GAV all as received by the local planning authority on 14 February 2012) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The close-boarded fencing shown on drawing WP4088-G-EXT-EL B shall be installed before the air conditioning units hereby approved are placed on site and shall be permanently retained and kept in good repair thereafter.
Condition : 4 - The air conditioning condensers shall not be operational outside of the hours of 8am to 8pm Monday to Fridays and 8am to 6pm on Saturdays.

Condition : 5 - The noise emitted from the air conditioning units, shall not be less than 10dB(A) below the existing background noise levels (Laeq), when measured from the nearest noise sensitive receptor, over any period when they units are operating
description: The installation of the external plant with screening to the rear ground floor of the property
